title: Loaded Broccoli Potatoes
steps:
Pierce the potatoes.
Microwave 12-15 min,
turning halfway

Steam broccoli, warm
beans. Melt cheddar into
warm milk + butter

Split + fluff. Load up,
top with sour cream
+ green onions
vo: Potato night, ready in thirty minutes.
You need four russet potatoes, broccoli, sharp cheddar, black beans, sour cream, milk, butter and green onions.
Pierce the potatoes and microwave them for twelve to fifteen minutes, turning halfway.
Steam the broccoli, warm the black beans, and melt the cheddar into warm milk and butter for a quick cheese sauce.
Split the potatoes, load them up, and top with sour cream and green onions.
